name: Multi Theft Auto
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Multi Theft Auto, the multiplayer mod for Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas. Installs the current server with the default resources; add your own in mods/deathmatch/resources.

config.startup: {"done": "Server started and is ready to accept connections"}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Multi Theft Auto: San Andreas. Downloads the current MTA server for the
# node's CPU from multitheftauto.com. Settings (mtaserver.conf, acl.xml),
# resources and databases are never touched once they exist; the default
# resources are only added on the first install.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
dl=https://linux.multitheftauto.com/dl
get() { curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$2" "$1"; }
case "$(uname -m)" in
x86_64) pkg=multitheftauto_linux_x64 bin=mta-server64 ;;
aarch64) pkg=multitheftauto_linux_arm64 bin=mta-server-arm64 ;;
*) echo "Multi Theft Auto has no server for $(uname -m)."; exit 1 ;;
esac

build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$build"
mkdir -p "$build"
trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT

echo "Downloading the MTA server ($pkg)"
get "$dl/$pkg.tar.gz" "$build/mta.tar.gz" || { echo "multitheftauto.com can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."; exit 1; }
tar -xzf "$build/mta.tar.gz" -C "$build"
[ -x "$build/$pkg/$bin" ] || { echo "The download has no $bin in it."; exit 1; }
# The server's own files only: mods/deathmatch keeps the user's settings.
cp -a "$build/$pkg/." .
ln -sfn "$bin" mta-server

mkdir -p mods/deathmatch/resources mods/deathmatch/logs
missing=0
for f in mtaserver.conf acl.xml vehiclecolors.conf; do [ -f "mods/deathmatch/$f" ] || missing=1; done
if [ "$missing" = 1 ]; then
    echo "Adding the default settings"
    get "$dl/baseconfig.tar.gz" "$build/baseconfig.tar.gz"
    tar -xzf "$build/baseconfig.tar.gz" -C "$build"
    for f in "$build"/baseconfig/*; do
        [ -e "mods/deathmatch/${f##*/}" ] || cp -a "$f" mods/deathmatch/
    done
fi
if [ -z "$(ls -A mods/deathmatch/resources)" ]; then
    echo "Adding the default resources"
    get https://mirror-cdn.multitheftauto.com/mtasa/resources/mtasa-resources-latest.zip "$build/resources.zip"
    unzip -q "$build/resources.zip" -d mods/deathmatch/resources
fi
echo "Installed the current MTA server ($bin)."

variables.description: The name shown in the server browser.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: The most players connected at once.

variables.name: HTTP port
variables.description: The TCP port players download resources from. Allocate it to the server too.
